invariants.rationale: data is dereferenced in the method body (data.stream()), so it must be non-null.
func is passed to a wrapper method and eventually used, so it should be non-null at method entry.
parallelism is passed as an Integer and used in related methods throughout the class, so it should be non-null.
A List is either empty or has a positive size; this captures the possible state of data, excluding null due to prior null-check.
parallelism typically represents the number of threads or partitions and is expected to be positive for meaningful parallel execution.
